## Core Architectural Offerings

### 1. Turnkey Residential & Commercial Interiors
- Scope: 3D concept visualization, false ceiling framing with concealed 3000K warm LED channels, mood lighting design, wall cladding, and complete carpentry.
- Materials: High-density water-resistant HDHMR, pre-laminated marine boards, zero VOC architectural finishes.
- Timeline: Fast modular execution completed in 15–30 days for typical 2BHK/3BHK configurations.
- Pricing model: Transparent BOQ based on measured carpet area, zero hidden extras.

### 2. Moisture-Proof Wall Cladding & Louvers
- Charcoal Louvers: High-density polystyrene composite, moisture proof, termite proof, zero paint odor. Ideal for living room TV feature walls, bed headboards, and executive cabins.
- WPC Exterior Fluted Panels: Weather-resistant wood-plastic composite profiles for balcony ceilings, facades, and exterior highlights.
- UV Marble Sheets: 8 ft x 4 ft seamless PVC-marble composite slabs with high-gloss protective polyurethane coating. Zero civil demolition, installs directly over existing tiled or plastered walls in under 48 hours.

### 3. Modular Kitchen Design
- Carcass: 100% Boiling Waterproof (BWP) Action TESA HDHMR grade boards.
- Hardware: Soft-close tandem drawers, hydraulic lift-ups, corner carousels (Blum/Hettich compatible).
- Finishes: Anti-fingerprint acrylic, matte PU, and quartz stone countertops with anti-stain sealant.

### 4. Acoustic uPVC Window & Door Systems
- Profile: Multi-chamber lead-free uPVC frames with galvanized steel reinforcement.
- Glazing: Double-glazed sealed acoustic glass units cutting up to 40 dB exterior traffic noise.
- Protection: EPDM weather gaskets eliminating monsoon rainwater leaks and street dust ingress.
